instrument: xml resolvable-class census — the analyzer's own classes cross-tabulated against the GATE'S OWN RULE (classifyEdge imported from script/m14/incoming-rule.ts)

control.rule: the no-claim column must reproduce script/m14/incoming-gate.ts's per-type table on this population (resolved / ambDecl / unresolved); a mismatch means this walk is not the gate's walk

clause3_unresolvedAudit.note: every edge classified `unresolved` in its OWN project, checked against the pooled corpus key space

fileClaimProbe.note: priced only; an unadmitted candidate REFUTES a file claim, and extFAIL must be 0

mappingProposed.references_builtin_external: isExternalTarget (owner claim) — identifier targets, verified when undeclared, never refuted for path-like spellings
mappingProposed.references_unresolved: no claim: the analyzer's own X13 class states the file does not satisfy the reference; marking it external would assert a fact about the population that the analyzer did not measure
mappingProposed.imports_remote: isExternalTarget (owner claim) — a URI is path-like, so the honest outcome is externalUnverified, never a false verification
mappingProposed.imports_file: no claim unless the candidate is an admitted file — priced in fileClaimProbe
